comments.text: From my understanding, the reason why he leaves these 3 casters is so that the wave will stay in a safe spot near his turret while he recalls and Neeko stays in lane, plus it helps with denying Aphelios creeps and puts him in an unsafe position (in case aphe no flash = free gank). Another reason is that if he decided to, he could have pulled the remaining 3 casters from the next wave to start a freeze or slow push which would severely hurt aphe or help guma, depending on who is leading the lane.

comments.text: 3 casters are not enough to hold a freeze, even when they are full hp. It can keep the 2nd wave close to the tower. But the only reason it pushed is bcs the enemy pushed the lane.
